pitch: I want to make a pixel art game about a fat little quokka from rottnest island who falls asleep on a rubbish barge after gorging himself on scraps and wakes up in a landfill on mainland Western Australia. He has to find his way home. There are funny interactions with other animals, it's all very Aussie, a little crude but still mostly PG (like Sam and max hit the road). Some character ideas - ravens that say cuuuuunt, sea goals that say maaaaaate, bin chickens (ibis). Give a 90s throwback vibe. Setting examples include beach, wheat fields, gold mine site, urban, something iconic…

summary.logline: A fat little quokka from Rottnest Island falls asleep on a rubbish barge after gorging himself on scraps, wakes up in a landfill on mainland Western Australia, and has to find his way home.
tone: like Sam & Max Hit the Road

quokka.personality: Fat, cheeky, always hungry, eternally optimistic
quokka.look: A chubby quokka: small round ears, short face, big happy smile, grey-brown fur, pot belly full of scraps

ibis.look: Australian white ibis: white body, bald black head, long curved black beak

seagull.personality: Loud, greedy, friendly once fed. Catchphrase: maaaaaate
seagull.look: Silver gulls: white, grey wings, red beaks and legs

raven.personality: Deadpan, rude, secretly helpful. Catchphrase: cuuuuunt
raven.look: Glossy black Australian ravens with pale eyes

beats.title: Wake up in the tip
beats.text: Davo gorged himself on scraps, fell asleep on a rubbish barge and woke up in a landfill on mainland WA.

beats.title: The toll
beats.text: The Bin Chickens won’t let Davo leave the landfill without paying a pastry toll.

beats.title: Maaaaaate
beats.text: At the beach, the Seagulls trade directions for chips.

beats.title: The wheatbelt
beats.text: Lost in the wheat, Davo asks the Ravens for directions. They are rude about it.

beats.title: Safety first
beats.text: The gold mine won’t let anyone through without hi-vis.

beats.title: Freo
beats.text: In Fremantle, Davo needs a ferry ticket to get home.

beats.title: Home
beats.text: Davo makes it back to his burrow on Rottnest Island.

rooms.landfill: Where Davo wakes up. Mountains of rubbish, a bulldozer and two bin chickens running a toll booth.
rooms.beach: A Cottesloe-style beach with a jetty and a fish and chip kiosk. Seagull territory.
rooms.wheat_fields: Golden wheatbelt, a silo, a rusty ute and two ravens on the fence.
rooms.gold_mine: A Kalgoorlie-style open-cut pit. No hi-vis, no entry.
rooms.fremantle: Fremantle’s Cappuccino Strip; the Rottnest ferry leaves from the harbour.
rooms.rottnest: Home: white sand, turquoise bay, the lighthouse and Davo’s burrow.
